# ProgressRing

Shows how full a bounded resource is.

`SuDuAI.ProgressRing` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.ProgressRing />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.ProgressRing"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Radial gauge for saturation-style metrics (context window, quota).

## Props (ProgressRingProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | Percentage 0–100. |
| `size` | `number` | Outer box size in px. Default 48. |
| `stroke` | `number` | Stroke width in the 36-unit viewBox. Default 3. |
| `color` | `string` | Arc color. Default neon #00F5A9. |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | Renders the centered percentage. Default true. |
